# kion_billing_source_anthropic (Resource)

Manages an Anthropic billing source (an Anthropic organization) in Kion. Requires Kion 3.16 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_billing_source_anthropic" "example" {
  # Required
  admin_api_key      = "example"
  billing_start_date = "example"
  name               = "example"

  # Optional
  # analytics_api_key = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin...). Kion uses it to read the organization's usage and validates it with Anthropic on create. Kion never returns it, so it is not read back.
- `billing_start_date` (String) First month Kion reads billing data for, as YYYY-MM.
- `name` (String) Name of the billing source.

### Optional

- `analytics_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Anthropic Enterprise Analytics API key, provisioned at claude.ai with the read:analytics scope. Kion never returns it, so it is not read back.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_id` (String) The Anthropic organization the Admin API key belongs to, resolved by Kion when the billing source is created.
